subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It affects who can walk, wait, work, and travel safely.”?
options: A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.
Sometimes discipline becomes a lesson for people watching.
People need quiet spaces before the world enters.
In a hotter world, shade becomes public health.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes discipline becomes a lesson for people watching.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It affects who can walk, wait, work, and travel safely. In a hotter world, shade becomes public health.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It affects who can walk, wait, work, and travel safely. In a hotter world, shade becomes public health.」，答案為「In a hotter world, shade becomes public health.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「In a hotter world, shade becomes public health.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
